native_mechanisms: Each mark is poured into the already-soured cup and the cup's changed colour seeds the next pour, so the whole pile passes as one unbroken chained pour (streaming single-accumulator fold).

The cup's final colour is carried through seven organs in turn, each bending it and discarding half of what it received, keeping only what refuses to sit still (seven-stage finalizer alternating shift-discard and bend).
Change one mark anywhere in the pile, re-pour from the first cup, and condemn the method if the new token resembles the old (avalanche/differential self-test as an acceptance gate).
core_technique: MurmurHash3-x64-style hash: 8-byte words multiplied/rotated/multiplied and XOR-folded into one rotating accumulator (h = rotl(h)*5 + C) with a byte-wise rotate-add tail and length injection, closed by a 7-step xor-shift/multiply fmix-style finalizer; no avalanche test exists in the code.
